output.one_liner: An all-in-one commerce platform for creating online stores, accepting payments, and selling across multiple channels.

auth.notes: OAuth2 with authorization code flow for standalone/API-only apps and client credentials flow for internal stores. Requests authenticated with X-Shopify-Access-Token header.

evidence.snippet: they authenticate using the OAuth authorization code grant flow: redirect the merchant to Shopify, get their approval, and exchange a code for an access token
If your app only acts on stores in your own Shopify organization, use the client credentials grant instead.
Send the access token in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header on every GraphQL Admin API request.

access.notes: Pages mention free 3-day trial and plans starting at ₹20/month but do not explicitly state whether API credentials are available during the trial or only on paid plans.

evidence.snippet: Shopify starts with a free 3-day trial—no credit card required. After your trial, most plans start at just ₹20 per month
You have your app's client ID and client secret from the Dev Dashboard.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Leaky bucket algorithm with per-API limits varying by plan. GraphQL Admin API charged by calculated query cost.

evidence.snippet: GraphQL Admin API, REST Admin API, Customer Account API, Payments Apps API, Partner API, App Events API
Most Shopify rate limits are enforced with a leaky bucket. Each app has access to a bucket.
When your app needs information about specific events that have occurred on a shop, it can subscribe to Shopify webhook topics
For agent skills and the Dev MCP server, see the Shopify AI Toolkit

buildability.rationale: API is comprehensively documented (GraphQL, REST, webhooks, rate limits) but developer access to credentials without paid plan is not documented in provided pages.

overview_evidence.snippet: Shopify is an all-in-one commerce platform that lets you create an online store, accept payments, and sell in person, on social channels, and in AI chats

unknown_reasons.access: Pages show free 3-day trial and ₹20/month paid plans but do not explicitly document whether API credentials are obtainable during trial period or require paid subscription.
unknown_reasons.mcp: Pages mention 'Shopify AI Toolkit' and 'Dev MCP server' but provide no URL, documentation, or details about official MCP server publication or community implementations.
